items.title: Anti-inflammatory peptide shows potential to prevent diabetes-related vision loss
items.text: According to a study published in October in the journal Biomedicine & Pharmacotherapy, a molecule naturally produced by the human body may help protect vision against damage caused by high blood sugar. This finding paves the way for new strategies to prevent diabetic retinopathy. This complication affects more than 22% of people with diabetes worldwide. It occurs when high blood sugar levels cause inflammation and damage neurons and blood vessels in the retina, which can lead to permanent vision loss.
